title: Stability of photoelectrochemical cells based on colloidal quantum dots
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3513-3534
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00587B, Review Article
Kanghong Wang, Yi Tao, Zikun Tang, Haiguang Zhao, Xuhui Sun, Federico Rosei, Dong Liu, Yujie Xiong
This review gives systematic analysis of degradation reasons of QD-based PEC cell and strategies improving stability from aspects including band structure, shapes, ligands of QDs, QDs’ matrix, co-catalysts, encapsulation and counter-electrodes.
